keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! RB Leipzig 0, Augsburg 1. Anton Kade (Augsburg) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Finn Dahmen (Augsburg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
David Raum (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! RB Leipzig 1, Augsburg 1. Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Brajan Gruda.
Goal! RB Leipzig 2, Augsburg 1. Christopher Nkunku (RB Leipzig) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Brajan Gruda.
Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! RB Leipzig 3, Augsburg 1. David Raum (RB Leipzig) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the top right corner.
First Half ends, RB Leipzig 3, Augsburg 1.
Substitution, Augsburg. Alexis Claude-Maurice replaces Arijon Ibrahimovic.
